arguments.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: illustration. Asset type: production prop reference sheet, P1, Arcs 3–4. Create ONE landscape PNG at native 1536 × 1024 pixels. Seven complete isolated prop groups on one seamless flat light-grey #E9E9EC canvas. Neutral studio key light from upper left; crisp opaque cel shadows, restrained metal highlight bands. No back light. No environment or border, no human, hand, mannequin or scale silhouette, no labels. Keep all objects fully inside the canvas with generous uncluttered grey gutters. These are enlarged independent detail studies, not one shared physical tabletop scale.

REFERENCE IMAGE 1 is an APPROVED house-style and continuity reference. Use ONLY its lower-middle industrial chain detail for the matte-black steel, smooth uniform link construction, machined surface and small incised diamond-outline stamp. Do not depict the knight, cuff, sword, towers, armour or any other object from the reference. All seven subjects below come from the text. Match its clean ink and hard cel shading, with fewer little shading fragments.

COMPOSITION: one tall stake at far left spanning nearly full canvas height. To its right place six separated groups in a spacious 3-column by 2-row arrangement. Upper row: compass, phone, lamp. Lower row: chain link, open kimbap box with USB, long ladle. The stake and ladle are the two long narrow silhouettes; keep the ladle large enough to see the bowl, diagonally across its cell, never cropped. Absolutely no labels or framing rectangles.

1. FAR LEFT, Kanghan sealing stake: one BLACK STEEL stake, one metre long in actual use, straight robust rectangular shaft tapering to a chisel-like pointed foot, broad compact reinforced head. On the head is one SILVER DOUBLE-HEXAGON emblem, one hexagon inside another, engraved as geometry without a letter. Directly below is a small inset glowing TIMER DISPLAY. Its screen is perfectly flat solid chroma green #00FF00, entirely BLANK for lettering later: no digits, glyphs, ticks, bars or UI. A slight local glow is confined to the screen recess; do not colour the whole shaft. A purposeful cable socket can be visible but no cable bundle or backpack.

2. UPPER MIDDLE LEFT, Sora's ORIGINAL CORE COMPASS: small coin-purse-sized round tarnished BRASS case, glass face in three-quarter top view, a single pointed sliver of smoky violet boss core #8F6FC4 as the needle, visibly mounted on the central pivot. A faint violet glow ONLY at the crystal. Plain unlettered pale dial, no cardinal letters or numerals. A SHORT BRASS CHAIN attaches to the case bail and closes into a wearable wrist-size loop with a small clasp, fully visible. This original compass is worn on her RIGHT wrist in the story, but draw only the object and its complete chain loop. No silver-cased replacement.

3. UPPER MIDDLE RIGHT, Minseok's OLD PHONE: one modest old smartphone shown rear three-quarter, screen facing away. Thick cracked SAFETY-ORANGE protective case #F26A1B, two or three credible localized cracks and scuffed corners. Simple older single-camera module. On its back is a small yellow THUMBS-UP pictogram sticker: a recognisable raised thumb and folded fingers, no face or letters. No logo and no extra camera lenses. Keep it unwrapped so the case and sticker are plainly readable.

4. UPPER FAR RIGHT, Minseok's LAMP: one detached old rusted trap-tester HARD-HAT LAMP, not a lantern and not a helmet. A squat round metal lamp housing with glass lens, rusty mounting clip and tilt hinge underneath, old steel with localized rust patches. A narrow strip of FADED ORANGE VEST CLOTH is visibly snagged in the clip, hanging down; only two or three small frayed threads. The lamp is OFF, its lens grey and reflective. Everything mechanically attached.

5. LOWER MIDDLE LEFT, stamped CHAIN LINK: a single palm-pocket-sized matte-black modern FACTORY STEEL oval chain link, thick uniform section with a small flattened machined face. On that face stamp the same small plain DIAMOND OUTLINE as the lower-middle reference link. It is incised into steel, no gem, raised badge, letters or double-hexagon substitution. Draw the isolated closed link at a useful enlarged angle, without a chain, cuff or extra fragments.

6. LOWER MIDDLE RIGHT, Choi's KIMBAP BOX WITH USB: an open cheap rectangular TAKEAWAY BOX, simple paper outside and FOIL LINING drawn in only a few flat silver planes. Its plain hinged lid is folded up behind. Inside, two orderly rows of cut kimbap rolls: dark seaweed wraps, white rice and small yellow, green and orange filling shapes. A cheap unbranded SILVER USB-A FLASH DRIVE, no lanyard, is visibly tucked BETWEEN the rolls; its exposed rectangular metal connector and two simple rectangular holes make it clearly a USB stick. One USB only, no chopsticks, packets or extra food.

7. LOWER FAR RIGHT, Auntie Geum's LADLE: one big LONG-HANDLED STEEL COOKING LADLE, plain sturdy utilitarian steel, a deep ROUND HEMISPHERICAL BOWL visibly connected to one long narrow metal handle, with a small bent hanging hook at the handle end. Shown diagonally with the open bowl facing the viewer so it reads as a ladle, not a spoon or frying pan. No decoration, no wood grip and no detached pieces. This is the ladle she uses in her RIGHT hand; draw only the prop.

QUALITY: each object has a few large opaque hard cel shadow planes, clean black tapered contours and only small purposeful wear marks. No realistic brushed-metal grain, tiny all-over texture, excessive reflective facets, soft optical edges or painterly surfaces. Background stays a single flat light grey with only tiny restrained contact shadows. No colours or glows not explicitly assigned above. Do not add any other objects.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.

Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

One clean 1536 × 1024 PNG prop design sheet in V2 cinematic cel for entry P1. Flat light-grey #E9E9EC background, soft neutral key from upper left.
